summary: Caller claims you have a missed $1,000 car loan payment and threatens to lock your bank account in 48 hours unless you enter bank details into a link they send.

reasons.explanation: Caller poses as your bank regarding a loan you supposedly missed.

evidence.quote: we are calling about your current bank loan that you are missing. We need you to pay off a loan of $1,000.

reasons.explanation: Claims an unrecognized missed car payment.

evidence.quote: You missed a payment on your car last month.

reasons.explanation: Demands payment within 48 hours or account will be locked.

evidence.quote: If you don't pay that in the next 48 hours, unfortunately your bank is going to be shut down.
your bank account is going to be locked out of your bank account if that payment is not made in 48 hours.

reasons.explanation: Asks you to click a link and enter bank info.

evidence.quote: I'm going to go ahead and send you a link.
Go ahead and click on that link, type in your bank info into the link we give.

recommended_action: Hang up immediately. Call your bank using the number on your card or app to verify any real issues.
